visual_review: Two right-facing workers at a conveyor band on VRECT_L: ring heads (r4) with a forward cap brim, flat shoulder top exactly 8 below each head (certified, mark_human_figure), rounded backs, upper arms dropping from the shoulder and forearms reaching forward onto the belt. Directional hunched bodies avoid the two-eyes-over-a-box face reading of the rejected drawing. Checked light/dark at 48. Human refs: full_body_ref (leaning figure reaching into the bin) and user.svg.
omissions: Belt roller circles omitted: a belt tall enough for rollers 8 from its walls leaves no height for the bodies; the cap line is a forward brim instead of a line through the head (a line through an r4 head leaves undersized holes).
